description.en:
Sets both teams' scores to exact values at once, from a 2-element array (CMND_BTL_ADD_POINT adds to them instead). Scores are capped at 99; negative values are ignored.

With true as second argument, the two values are also copied into the match setup data, in a pair of fields kept apart from the live score. The only shipped use is a story match that starts with the player's team already down 0-10.
true to also copy the scores into the match setup data.

examples.case: Starting a story match already losing 0-10 (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
